author: (Megerle von Mühlfeld, 1816)

note.en: A small, glossy snail with fine lines on its shell, up to about 1.8 cm long, that lives on sand. Known here from 5 museum specimen records (Gandoca-Manzanillo refuge, Sixaola river mouth, Cahuita, Limón, 1945 to 2003).
note.es: Un caracol pequeño y brillante con líneas finas en la concha, de hasta unos 1,8 cm, que vive en arena. Conocido aquí por 5 registros de ejemplares de museo (Gandoca-Manzanillo refugio, Sixaola river mouth, Cahuita, Limón, 1945 a 2003).

evidence: GBIF: 5 specimen records in the region (Gandoca-Manzanillo refuge, Sixaola river mouth, Cahuita, Limón, 1945 to 2003)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (museum specimens), Gandoca to Limón

marks.en: Small glossy shell with thin brown spiral lines broken into dashes.
marks.es: Concha pequeña y brillante con finas líneas espirales pardas interrumpidas.
